2.99.15
ChartSeries.Style
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The ChartSeries.Style element specifies the style properties for a ChartSeries. This element is
optional. This element is of type Style.
Following is the parent element of the ChartSeries.Style element.
Parent elements
ChartSeries
The following is the XML Schema definition of the ChartSeries.Style element.
 <xsd:element name="Style" type="StyleType" minOccurs="0" />
